description: This file is a PHP template that renders the OAuth user confirmation and registration form as part of an authentication workflow. It processes user data from OAuth providers, handles form rendering with validation states, and includes hidden inputs to pass OAuth tokens and user data.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues, used here for user name processing.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the response page.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section within the layout where inner content is inserted.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Fetches localized or template-specific text strings for display.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Completes rendering and outputs the final content.
